args.title: Filter out empty lines in src/ingest/parser.ts to prevent shape mismatch
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Filter out completely empty lines, or lines consisting solely of whitespace or carriage returns, in parseStatement before processing rows to prevent shape mismatch errors.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, trailing newlines, blank lines in the middle, or extra empty lines can leave empty lines or lines with just '\r' that split into a single empty field, triggering a shape mismatch error against the header. We should filter out completely empty lines or lines consisting solely of whitespace or carriage returns in parseStatement before processing rows.
